# Product Requirement: Clear Notification Copy

Requirement ID: REQ-BRIEF-001
Product Definition Profile: brief
Product Review: confirmed

## Problem / Background

The existing success notice uses an ambiguous phrase already identified in the source conversation.

## Target User / Scenario

A signed-in customer reads the notice after the existing successful action.

## Goal / Expected Product Outcome

Use the confirmed sentence so the existing successful outcome is immediately understandable.

## In Scope

- Replace the one confirmed notice sentence.

## Out Of Scope / Non-goals

- No behavior, role, state, permission, workflow, or recovery change.

## Acceptance Direction

- The successful action displays the confirmed sentence and all behavior remains unchanged.
